description: An LED blinker. Module `blinker` with a parameter N (default 4), inputs clk, rst_n (active-low reset) and en, and output led. While en is 1 the LED toggles every N clock cycles: it turns on at the Nth rising clock edge at which en is 1, turns off N edges later, and so on. When en is 0 the LED is off and the count starts over. Reset turns the LED off.

starter.title: LED blinker
starter.summary: Blinks an LED every N clock cycles while enabled.
